summary: Sysco Corp and numerous wholly owned subsidiaries filed a Rule 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-09-24 under an existing shelf registration (File 333-298926), covering an ordinary debt or equity takedown by the grocery wholesaler. The excerpt discloses only registrant identification and co-registrant guarantor entities; no price per share, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations mechanics are stated. This is a routine capital-markets shelf takedown, not a transformative event. Watch for pricing terms and use of proceeds in the accompanying free-writing prospectus; no risk-arb angle applies.
